item.title: Your first debugging session: check the build first
item.description: Match the executable to its source and stop at main before investigating a larger program.

item.title: Choosing breakpoints that narrow down a bug
item.description: Use function, source-line, and address breakpoints to find where a value first goes wrong.

item.title: Step into, Step over, and Step out
item.description: Understand instruction-level stepping and decide when to follow a function call.

item.title: Reading registers: PC, SP, and return values
item.description: Start with register roles instead of trying to memorize every name.

item.title: Following a failure through the call stack
item.description: Separate the function that stopped from the caller that supplied the bad input.

item.title: Reading a hex dump: addresses, bytes, and text
item.description: Interpret memory without confusing storage locations, integer values, and character data.

item.title: What to check after an access violation
item.description: Inspect the faulting instruction, accessed address, and caller before changing code.

item.title: Trace a null pointer before adding a check
item.description: Find whether a missing object is an expected result or a broken initialization contract.

item.title: Finding off-by-one errors at array boundaries
item.description: Separate element counts, last indices, and byte capacities when investigating a loop.

item.title: Use-after-free: readable memory can still be invalid
item.description: Trace ownership and object lifetime instead of relying on a pointer’s numeric value.

item.title: When a variable is optimized out
item.description: Check optimization and debug information before assuming that a missing variable is a bug.

item.title: Missing function names and debug symbols
item.description: Match the binary, symbols, and source before interpreting question marks in the stack.

item.title: Troubleshooting Attach by PID
item.description: Verify the process, debugger platform, and architecture before changing permissions.

item.title: It runs in the terminal but fails in the debugger
item.description: Compare arguments, working directories, and environment variables before changing the program.

item.title: Why addresses change between runs
item.description: Distinguish absolute addresses from code locations when reusing a breakpoint.

item.title: Reading a Python traceback from the error back to its caller
item.description: Identify the exception and failing expression before tracing where the input came from.

item.title: Tracing JavaScript undefined property errors
item.description: Check response shape and asynchronous timing before adding blanket fallback values.

item.title: Undefined reference is a link failure, not a runtime crash
item.description: Find the missing definition and link input before opening the debugger.

item.title: Reducing a reproduction without removing the bug
item.description: Preserve the failure conditions while simplifying code and input one change at a time.

item.title: When to use logs and when to stop at a breakpoint
item.description: Choose between a moment-in-time inspection and a record of events over time.
